okf_upgrade.note: This bundle remains a supported OKF v0.1 bundle. Superbee can author and mutate v0.2, but changing index.md alone is not a migration: OKF v0.2 reserves top-level status for draft|stable|deprecated, while the listed kinds use it for workflow state.
help: Model workflow progress as logical progress_status across conventions, documents, Views, and saved queries before changing okf_version.
Superbee does not currently perform this multi-file migration automatically.
